_README.warning: EVERY NUMERIC VALUE IN THIS FILE IS A PLACEHOLDER. None of it is verified against an official scheme guideline. Do not put any figure from this file on a demo slide or in a pitch until 'verified' is true and 'source_url' points at a real document.

provenance_legend.ps_text: Stated in the SIH26092 problem statement itself. Indicative only — the PS contradicts itself on interest rates (background says 6.5-8%, deliverable 2 says 6.5-15%), so treat even these as unverified.
provenance_legend.placeholder: Invented purely to make the schema concrete and the tests runnable. Has no basis. MUST be replaced.
provenance_legend.official_guideline: Transcribed from the sponsoring corporation's published scheme guideline. Only these may be shown publicly.

_README.how_to_use: Two team members transcribe the official guidelines into this file independently, then diff and reconcile. Flip 'verified' to true only for values you can point at in a source document. Any row still false at demo time goes in VERIFY.md and stays off the slides.
_README.schema_note: Interest rates deliberately live in 'interest_rules' as condition-keyed bands, not as a scalar, because these schemes band rates by loan size and applicant category. A single rate column would force a hardcoded inaccuracy.
_README.null_semantics: A null 'value' means UNKNOWN, not zero. The engine treats a null required parameter as NOT COMPUTABLE and reports the missing parameter path — it never substitutes a default. See src/core/finance/loan.ts.
_README.demo_overlay_note: Because almost every value here is null, the engine cannot produce figures from this file alone. data/schemes.demo-overlay.json supplies exercisable NON-AUTHORITATIVE values so tests, the personas CLI and the UI can run. Any result computed with the overlay carries figures_authoritative:false and the UI renders a permanent banner. Never merge overlay values into this file.

_CHANGELOG: 2026-08-26 — structural additions only, no provenanced value altered: (a) added 'tenure_includes_moratorium' as an explicit field because ROADMAP §8.1 lists it as an open question and it must not be an assumption; (b) added 'cost_ceiling_rules' to EDU because ROADMAP §6 flags that education schemes set separate ceilings for study in India vs abroad and one scalar ceiling would force a wrong number; (c) split the composite predicate 'CATEGORY_SC_VERIFIED' into 'CATEGORY_SC' and 'CASTE_CERT_AVAILABLE' so remediation can name a single concrete action — a composite predicate cannot yield a minimum qualifying change; (d) added 'INCOME_PROOF_AVAILABLE' for the same reason; (e) added 'min_project_cost' distinct from 'min_loan' because ROADMAP asks for the floor that separates MICRO from TERM and a cost floor and a loan floor are different things.

max_unit_cost.note: PS states micro projects 'up to ₹1.40 lakh'. Confirm whether this is the unit cost ceiling or the loan ceiling — they are different things.

max_loan.note: Likely lower than max_unit_cost once margin money is applied. VERIFY.

min_project_cost.note: Added field. A cost floor, if any, below which no scheme applies.

loan_pct_cap.note: PS states assistance covers 'up to 90% of project or education costs'.

margin_pct.note: Beneficiary own-contribution share. Not stated in the PS. VERIFY.

subsidy_pct.note: Many such schemes carry a subsidy component. Confirm whether one exists here.

subsidy_timing.note: FRONT reduces the loan and therefore the EMI; BACK is adjusted at closure and leaves the EMI unchanged. Getting this wrong changes every number on screen.

moratorium_interest_treatment.note: One of CAPITALISED | SERVICED | WAIVED. This is the single most consequential unverified field in the file.

tenure_months_max.note: Also confirm whether tenure is inclusive or exclusive of the moratorium.

tenure_includes_moratorium.note: Added field. ROADMAP §8.1 open question. If true, repayment months = tenure_months_max − moratorium; if false, repayment months = tenure_months_max. The engine refuses to guess.

allowed_partner_types.note: Which partner classes may actually process this category is central to the routing feature. VERIFY carefully.

interest_rules.note: PS gives 6.5%-8% in background and 6.5%-15% in deliverable 2. Do not pick one. Get the real rate card.

max_unit_cost.note: PS states larger projects 'up to ₹50.00 lakh'.

max_loan.note: VERIFY whether ₹50 lakh is the project ceiling or the loan ceiling.

min_loan.note: There is probably a floor that separates TERM from MICRO. Finding it matters — it defines the boundary personas.

min_project_cost.note: Added field. The MICRO/TERM boundary expressed as project cost.

margin_pct.note: Likely higher than MICRO and may scale with loan size.

interest_rules.note: Almost certainly banded by loan size here. Expect two or three bands.

max_unit_cost.note: Education schemes usually set separate ceilings for study in India vs abroad. Model as two interest_rules / two ceilings, not one. See cost_ceiling_rules.

moratorium_months_min.note: Education loans commonly tie the moratorium to course duration plus a grace period rather than a fixed month count. If so, this field needs a different shape — flag it rather than forcing it.

moratorium_interest_treatment.note: Subsidised education schemes sometimes waive interest during study. Do not assume — verify.

cost_ceiling_rules.note: Added structure. VERIFY whether India-study has its own ceiling.
Added structure. VERIFY whether abroad-study has a higher ceiling.

annual_family_income_cap.note: PS states 'annual family income of up to ₹5.00 Lakhs'. Income ceilings on schemes like these have been revised more than once, so confirm the figure AND its effective date against the current guideline.

open_questions_for_phase_0: Which corporation sponsors this PS? The description matches a national SC finance and development corporation but never names it. Everything downstream depends on knowing whose guidelines are authoritative.
Is ₹1.40 lakh / ₹50 lakh the project cost ceiling or the loan ceiling?
Is there a subsidy component, and is it front-ended or back-ended?
What is the actual banded rate card, and does it vary by gender or applicant category?
Which moratorium interest treatment applies to each scheme?
Is the maximum tenure inclusive or exclusive of the moratorium?
What is the loan floor that separates MICRO from TERM?
Which partner types are actually authorised to process each scheme category? This is the backbone of the routing feature.
Does the education scheme have separate ceilings for study in India vs abroad?
Is the education moratorium a fixed month count or course-duration-plus-grace? If the latter, moratorium_months_* is the wrong shape and must become a formula field.

Can one applicant be eligible for more than one scheme at the same time? In this seed they cannot — the purpose lists are disjoint and the cost predicates mutually exclusive — so the engine's multi-scheme ranking never fires on real data. If the published guidelines do overlap, RECOMMENDATION_POLICY in src/core/recommend.ts becomes user-visible and needs review; see the known_gaps note in data/personas.fixtures.json.
